narrative: Developers shipped 5,842 new Spaces this week, all of them classifiable (100.0%). Conversational apps are the largest named use case at 903, ahead of image generation at 582 and data analysis at 461, though a residual "everything else" bucket of 1,822 sits above all of them. Vision-language is the most common technique at 7.0% of new Spaces, with agentic patterns at 6.5%; media and entertainment (9.7%) and consumer (9.4%) are the verticals most often pointed at. On the model side, 24,465 new models arrived, with Qwen the largest named family at 8,397.
